items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Revenue is supported only for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage is $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26, conflicting with a prior record of $963.5690377 and 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Continue only the existing finance reconciliation; do not authorize discretionary spend, commitments, forecasts, monetization expansion, requeues, or new production work. Minimum measurement: reconcile the AI records, produce a period-aligned cost ledger, establish owner-approved budget limits, and map revenue to site/content identifiers before reporting margin or ROI.
